interpretations: For each region with transaction-bearing accounts, average each account’s unsigned `trans.amount` values, then average those account averages; return regions above the unweighted average of the regional figures, with the requested difference and ratio.
Treat accounts with no transactions as having an account average of zero; include them when calculating their region’s figure and the unweighted average across regions.
Treat accounts with no transactions as zero and regions with no accounts as having a figure of zero; include every region in `district.A3` in the unweighted all-region average.
Ignore accounts with no transactions, but assign a figure of zero to regions with no transaction-bearing accounts; include those regions in the unweighted all-region average.
queries:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
regional_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS regional_average
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(regional_average) AS average_regional_figure
    FROM regional_averages
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.regional_average - o.average_regional_figure AS difference,
       r.regional_average / o.average_regional_figure AS ratio
FROM regional_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE r.regional_average > o.average_regional_figure

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           d.A3 AS region,
           COALESCE(AVG(t.amount), 0) AS account_average
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS region_average
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT AVG(region_average)
FROM region_averages
raw:
For each region with transaction-bearing accounts, average each account’s unsigned `trans.amount` values, then average those account averages; return regions above the unweighted average of the regional figures, with the requested difference and ratio.

Treat accounts with no transactions as having an account average of zero; include them when calculating their region’s figure and the unweighted average across regions.

Treat accounts with no transactions as zero and regions with no accounts as having a figure of zero; include every region in `district.A3` in the unweighted all-region average.
Ignore accounts with no transactions, but assign a figure of zero to regions with no transaction-bearing accounts; include those regions in the unweighted all-region average.
